_note: THE PAGE TABLE (phase 2 rung 0, INSTRUMENT-SPEC (1); the plan's DoD §3). One row per served page. path = the route under the Pages root. lang = the tongue of record at the DoD (Tagalog at the apex, English under /en/ — THE INTERIM serves English at both until pastor-check.txt; the fence reads the page's own lang attribute, dod-probe asserts the DoD tongue). pair = the DoD unit the page belongs to: five pairs count (home · what-next · card · contact · privacy); /story/ is OUTSIDE the count — it serves the day brother Daniel's words land. page = the shape build.mjs draws and the fence and the rig key on. needs.card = 'lines' (every line inside <section id="card"> ⊂ card.txt — the family's signature on every page) or 'whole' (/card/: the block == card.txt WHOLE and unbroken, the CARD-MATCH test's home; the print doors and the ribbon tab are siblings outside #card). needs.forty = the forty list REQUIRED (refs == verses.json, exactly one row revealed) or REFUSED on the page. needs.share = the share row may stand on the page. frame = the owner's four sheet lines (TR2-frame A): home = all four · challenge = Home only (the what-next door is the h1 and his clause is step 2) · foot = his clause + the what-next door + Home. hiddenUntil = the build flag that must be true before build.mjs writes the page (the absent-and-whole pattern). count = in dod-probe's eight. A route NOT in this table is fenced under the strictest default (card lines ⊂ card.txt, the forty required, no lifted shape) — the mock-ups under docs/preview/ until rung 2 retires them.
